epics.epic_description: Establish and maintain the definitive configuration for each pension scheme, including eligibility rules, status, effective dates, and a chronological audit trail of material changes while enforcing unique scheme identity.

stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want to create, configure, and maintain scheme details including eligibility rules, rules, status, and effective dates, so that scheme configuration is consistent and auditable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a new scheme record, when it is created with a scheme identifier, eligibility rules, rules, status, and effective date, then it is stored and cannot be duplicated for the same scheme.
2. Given a material scheme change, when it is captured, then the changing user, timestamp, and old/new values are recorded and retrievable for audit.
3. Given an attempt to create a duplicate scheme identity, when it is submitted, then it is prevented or explicitly flagged for review.

As a pension administrator, I want the platform to prevent or flag scheme changes that would break the unique identity agreement for each scheme, so that scheme records remain unambiguous.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a scheme identity check, when a duplicate identifier is detected, then creation is blocked or flagged for manual review.
2. Given an existing scheme, when a new scheme with the same identifier is attempted, then the system returns a clear uniqueness violation message.

epics.epic_description: Maintain accurate employer registration records, authorized contacts, and scheme associations so contributions can be attributed correctly and contact routing is reliable.

stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want to register and maintain employer records including employer identity, status, and authorized contact details, so that contributions can be attributed to the correct employer.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an employer registration, when it is submitted with identity, status, and contact details, then the employer is uniquely identifiable and stored.
2. Given an existing employer, when its status or details are updated, then the change is recorded with an effective date.

As a pension administrator, I want to maintain authorized contact records for each employer with recorded effective dates and reasons, so that communication and routing use current authorized contacts.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an authorized contact, when it is linked to a specific employer, then the linkage is stored and change history is recorded.
2. Given a contact retirement, when it is processed, then an effective date and reason are recorded and the contact is no longer active.

As a pension administrator, I want to associate each employer with the relevant scheme or schemes and record the effective date of each association, so that contributions are correctly attributed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an employer and scheme, when an association is established, then it is queryable and the effective date is recorded.
2. Given a historical association, when it is queried, then the historical association remains retrievable.

epics.epic_description: Enroll eligible members, maintain member records, and prevent duplicate or invalid registrations to ensure reliable, eligible, and deduplicated member records.

stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want to register and enroll members by capturing member identity and required membership attributes, so that eligible members are recorded reliably.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a member enrollment attempt that satisfies scheme eligibility rules, when it is submitted, then it is confirmed as eligible.
2. Given a member enrollment attempt that fails scheme eligibility rules, when it is submitted, then it is rejected or held for review with the reason recorded.

As a pension administrator, I want to maintain member records with material changes recorded for audit, so that member data remains accurate and traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a material member record change, when it is made, then the changing user, timestamp, and prior and new values are recorded.
2. Given a member record, when it is queried, then its change history is retrievable.

stories.summary: Prevent duplicate or invalid member registrations
stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want the platform to prevent or flag the creation of duplicate or invalid member registrations, so that member records remain clean and reliable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a duplicate member identity, when it is attempted, then it is prevented at creation or flagged for manual review.
2. Given an invalid member registration, when it is submitted, then it is flagged or rejected with the reason recorded.

epics.epic_description: Administer pension-account records and their associations with members and schemes, ensuring clear traceability to contributions, investments, and benefits without defining valuation or benefit-calculation logic.

stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want to administer pension-account records linked to a member and a scheme, so that accounts are reliably associated and queryable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a pension account, when it is created, then it is linked to exactly one member and one scheme and the linkage is auditable.
2. Given a pension account, when it is queried, then the member and scheme associations are returned.

stories.summary: Trace pension accounts to related records
stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want each pension account to maintain traceability to relevant contribution, investment, and benefit records, so that account activity is fully traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a pension account, when related records are queried, then the associated contribution, investment, and benefit records are retrievable.
2. Given a contribution, investment, or benefit record, when it is queried, then the linked pension account is identifiable.

As a pension administrator, I want changes to pension-account records to be recorded with an audit trail, so that account modifications are traceable without altering calculation logic.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a change to a pension account, when it is made, then the user, timestamp, and changed values are recorded.
2. Given a pension account change, when it is audited, then no calculation or valuation logic is altered.

epics.epic_description: Record contribution submissions, receipts, and allocations, reconcile submitted/received/allocated amounts, and track exceptions through resolution while preserving evidence of material financial actions.

stories.description:
As an employer, I want to submit contributions that are recorded with the submitted amount and submission date, so that contributions are traceable from submission.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a contribution submission, when it is recorded, then the submitted amount and submission date are captured and associated with a specific employer, member, and scheme.
2. Given a contribution submission, when it is queried, then the submission details and associated entities are returned.

As finance personnel, I want to record contribution receipts and associate each receipt with the relevant employer, member, and scheme, so that received funds are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a contribution receipt, when it is recorded, then it is associated with the relevant employer, member, and scheme.
2. Given a receipt, when it is matched to the corresponding submission, then any difference is flagged.

As finance personnel, I want to record allocation outcomes and associate each allocation with the relevant employer, member, scheme, and pension account, so that contributions are properly credited.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an allocation outcome, when it is recorded, then it is linked to the contribution and pension account and reflected in the reconciliation.
2. Given an allocation, when it is queried, then the associated employer, member, scheme, and pension account are returned.

stories.summary: Reconcile submitted, received, and allocated amounts
stories.description:
As finance personnel, I want submitted, received, and allocated amounts to be reconciled with unmatched amounts, discrepancies, invalid records, and failed transactions explicitly flagged, so that financial data is accurate and exceptions are visible.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given submitted, received, and allocated amounts for a contribution, when reconciliation runs, then any unmatched, discrepancy, invalid, or failed amounts are displayed as exceptions rather than marked complete.
2. Given a reconciliation view, when it is displayed, then stage-by-stage amounts and variances are shown.

As operations personnel, I want flagged exceptions to be tracked from identification through resolution with the resolution outcome recorded, so that discrepancies are actively resolved.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a flagged exception, when it is created, then it has a trackable status from open to resolved.
2. Given an exception resolution, when it is recorded, then the resolution outcome and actor are retained.

stories.summary: Preserve evidence of material financial actions
stories.description:
As compliance personnel, I want evidence of material financial actions including actor, timestamp, values, and outcome to be preserved, so that financial transactions are auditable end-to-end.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a material financial action, when it is performed, then the actor, timestamp, values, and outcome are recorded.
2. Given a financial action, when it is audited, then the end-to-end evidence is retrievable.

epics.epic_description: Maintain approved investment and allocation records linked to pension accounts, members, and schemes, recording changes with traceability while excluding investment trading and portfolio execution.

stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want to maintain approved investment and allocation records linked to the relevant pension account, member, and scheme, so that investments are reliably recorded.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an approved investment record, when it is created, then it is linked to a pension account and queryable.
2. Given an investment record, when it is queried, then the associated pension account, member, and scheme are returned.

As a pension administrator, I want changes to investment and allocation records to be recorded with traceability of who made each change and when, so that investment records remain auditable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a change to an investment or allocation record, when it is made, then the user, timestamp, and changed values are captured.
2. Given an investment record, when its change history is queried, then the audit trail is returned.

As a system administrator, I want the platform to treat investment trading, portfolio execution, and financial advice as out of scope unless explicitly approved, so that unauthorized functionality is not exposed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an attempt to access investment trading, portfolio execution, or financial advice, when it is made, then it is denied unless separately approved.
2. Given the investment module, when it is reviewed, then no trading or execution functions are exposed without explicit approval.

epics.epic_description: Record and validate benefit requests, route them through controlled review and approval workflows, and record decisions and payment outcomes.

stories.description:
As a pension scheme member, I want to submit benefit requests with required details and supporting documentation, so that my benefit requests are recorded and attributable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a benefit request, when it is recorded, then all required supporting details are captured and it is attributable to a member and scheme.
2. Given an incomplete benefit request, when it is submitted, then it is rejected or held until complete with the missing elements recorded.

stories.summary: Validate benefit requests against scheme rules
stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want benefit requests to be validated against confirmed scheme rules before proceeding, so that only compliant requests advance.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a benefit request that does not satisfy confirmed scheme rules, when it is validated, then it is flagged or rejected with the reason recorded.
2. Given a compliant benefit request, when it is validated, then it proceeds to the review stage.

stories.summary: Route benefit requests through review and approval
stories.description:
As a pension administrator, I want benefit requests to pass through a controlled review and approval workflow with decisions and approvers recorded, so that sensitive benefit actions are properly authorized.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a benefit request, when it enters the workflow, then it passes through review and approval stages with the decision and approver recorded.
2. Given a denied benefit request, when it is decided, then the denial reason and approver are recorded and the audit trail is preserved.

stories.summary: Track benefit request status and payment outcomes
stories.description:
As a pension scheme member, I want to see the processing status of my benefit request and have payment outcomes recorded, so that I can track my request and confirm payments.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a benefit request, when its status is queried, then the processing status is visible.
2. Given a benefit request with a payment, when it is completed, then the payment outcome is recorded.

epics.epic_description: Provide operational and financial reporting, visibility into processing status and reconciliation, and traceable records of material actions for accountability and audit review.

stories.description:
As management, I want to generate operational and financial reports that reflect current system data, so that I can review delivery outcomes and make strategic decisions.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an authorized user, when a report is requested, then operational and financial reports are generated that reflect current system data.
2. Given a report, when it is generated, then it is complete and consistent with the underlying system data.

stories.summary: Display processing status and reconciliation exceptions
stories.description:
As operations personnel, I want visibility into processing status, reconciliation discrepancies, and unresolved exceptions, so that I can monitor work queues and drive exception resolution.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a dashboard or report, when it is displayed, then processing status, reconciliation discrepancies, and unresolved exceptions are shown.
2. Given an unresolved exception, when it is queried, then its status and owner are visible.

stories.summary: Maintain traceable records of material actions
stories.description:
As compliance personnel, I want material actions and changes to be recorded with sufficient detail to be retrieved for audit, so that accountability is demonstrable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a material action or change, when it occurs, then it is recorded with user, timestamp, and changed values.
2. Given an audit query, when it is run, then material actions and changes are retrievable with sufficient detail.

stories.summary: Export audit records for audit review
stories.description:
As compliance personnel, I want audit records to be exportable or presentable in a format acceptable for audit review, so that external audit can be supported.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given audit records, when they are exported, then they are in a format acceptable for audit review.
2. Given an audit export, when it is generated, then it includes all relevant records, actions, and decisions.

epics.epic_summary: Security, Access Control, and Exception Handling
epics.epic_description: Enforce role-based access control for sensitive operations, maintain separation of submission, review, and approval responsibilities, and handle failed transactions and exceptions in a controlled manner.

stories.description:
As a system administrator, I want role-based access control to be enforced for all users and sensitive operations, so that unauthorized access is denied.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given an unauthorized user, when they attempt a sensitive operation, then access is denied.
2. Given a role, when permissions are assigned, then only authorized operations are accessible to that role.

stories.summary: Separate submission, review, and approval duties
stories.description:
As a compliance personnel, I want submission, review, and approval responsibilities to be separated for sensitive financial or benefit actions, so that no single user can complete the entire chain.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a sensitive financial or benefit action, when it requires separation, then the submitting, reviewing, and approving actors are distinguishable roles.
2. Given a single user, when they attempt to complete an entire sensitive action chain, then the system prevents it unless approved.

stories.summary: Handle failed transactions and exceptions controllably
stories.description:
As operations personnel, I want failed transactions and exceptions to be handled in a controlled manner and not silently completed, so that failures are visible and resolvable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given a failed transaction, when it occurs, then it is flagged and prevented from silent completion.
2. Given a failed transaction, when it is logged, then the transaction reference, failure reason, actor, and timestamp are recorded.
